name: video_cfg_apply_selection
column7: fullscreen flag) into g_video_cfg and sets version 5

name: video_dialog_init
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: fills the Select Video Mode dialog (4 performance checkboxes)

name: video_select_and_set_mode
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: loads videocfg.bin or shows the dialog then RwEngineSetSubSystem/SetVideoMode

name: controller_cfg_init
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: builds the defaults for 4 controllers (gamepads first then the keyboard) then loads contcfg files that still match the device; optionally shows the dialog

name: controller_action_pressed
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: tests one binding slot of a controller (gamepad button / analog axis / keyboard scancode)

name: controller_present
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: device type of controller n is not none

name: controller_poll_player
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: builds the per-player input state from the bindings

name: gamesave_gather
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: live state -> g_savegame (sets 0xDEADBEEF; copies the replay buffer and the 0xB64 byte game state block)

name: gamesave_apply
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: g_savegame -> live state (replay buffer and game state block)

name: autosave_request
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: prints starting autosave and arms the autosave state machine

name: gamesave_load_menu_state
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: state machine for the boot-time save check (memory-card style states from the console builds)

name: gamesave_format_state_machine
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: state machine for the format step

name: replay_buffer_alloc
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: allocates the ghost buffer; its size (0x4178C) must equal the sum of the track times * 7.5 frames

name: replay_save_at_race_end
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: writes ReplayN.rep and requests an autosave

name: replay_begin_race
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: sizes and creates the recording buffer for the course (course id +1000 when mirrored)

name: game_state_reset
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: clears the run time state and sets the default career progress (open/locked flags)

name: best_times_init_defaults
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: fills the 3 x 45 best time tables (9 min 59.xx s)

name: best_time_store
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: stores the current race time in the best time tables

name: career_event_won
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: marks a career cell done (2) and unlocks the next ones; requests an autosave

name: career_record_ptr
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: address of the 5 dword record of a course

name: @g_game_state
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: 0xB64 byte game state block saved in gamesave.bin

name: @g_replay_buffer
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: pointer to the 0x4178C byte ghost buffer

name: @g_mirror_mode
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: when set the course id is +1000

name: @g_savegame_state
comment (MFL.exe: settings files: game state block inside g_savegame (0xB64 bytes)
